if not (p/'id_ed25519').exists():subprocess.run(['ssh-keygen','-q','-t','ed25519','-N','','-f',str(p/'id_ed25519')],check=True)

(p/'user-data').write_text('#cloud-config\nusers:\n  - name: ac-test\n    groups: [sudo]\n    shell: /bin/bash\n    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n    lock_passwd: true\n    ssh_authorized_keys:\n      - '+(p/'id_ed25519.pub').read_text().strip()+'\nssh_pwauth: false\ndisable_root: true\n')

for _ in range(2):
 with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));ports.append(s.getsockname()[1])
ssh_port,api_port=ports
args=[str(q/'usr/bin/qemu-system-x86_64'),'-enable-kvm','-cpu','host','-smp','4','-m','6144','-machine','q35','-display','none','-vga','none','-monitor','none','-serial','file:'+str(p/'serial.log'),'-L',str(q/'usr/share/qemu'),'-bios',str(q/'usr/share/seabios/bios-256k.bin'),'-drive','file='+str(p/'disk.qcow2')+',if=virtio,format=qcow2','-drive','file='+str(p/'seed.iso')+',media=cdrom,readonly=on','-netdev',f'user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:{ssh_port}-:22,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:{api_port}-:6443','-device','virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0,romfile=']

collect-candidate-worker.py.script:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,urllib.parse
p=pathlib.Path('/root/storage-probe')
result=json.loads((p/'worker-observation.json').read_text())
config=json.loads((p/'worker-config.json').read_text())
def run(args,**kw):
    return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,**kw).strip()
def digest(path):
    with open(path,'rb') as f:return 'sha256:'+hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def kube(*args):return json.loads(run(['/usr/local/bin/k3s','kubectl',*args,'-o','json']))
def sql(db,query):
    return json.loads(run(['sudo','-u','postgres','psql','-X','-A','-t','-d',db,'-c',query]))
org=result['organization']
assert org.startswith('candidate_probe_') and org.removeprefix('candidate_probe_').isdigit()
result['database']=sql('accontrol',f"SELECT json_build_object('fsync',current_setting('fsync'),'synchronous_commit',current_setting('synchronous_commit'),'requests',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('request_id',r.request_id,'state',r.state,'generation',r.generation,'storage_bytes',r.storage_bytes,'dispatch_started',p.dispatch_started,'lease_epoch',p.lease_epoch,'lease_owner',p.lease_owner,'reason',p.reason,'has_receipt',p.receipt IS NOT NULL,'input_revision',i.revision,'manifest_digest',v.digest)) FROM runtime_start_requests r JOIN candidate_preparations p USING(organization,request_id) JOIN runtime_start_inputs i USING(organization,request_id) JOIN workspace_input_versions v ON v.organization=i.organization AND v.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND v.revision=i.revision WHERE r.organization='{org}'))")
result['metadata_database']=sql('jfsmeta',"SELECT json_build_object('fsync',current_setting('fsync'),'synchronous_commit',current_setting('synchronous_commit'))")
pvc=next(x for x in kube('get','pvc','-n','ac-kube-component')['items'] if x['metadata']['uid']==result['pvc_uid'])
pv=next(x for x in kube('get','pv')['items'] if x['metadata']['uid']==result['pv_uid'])
result['kubernetes_objects']={'pvc':pvc,'pv':pv}
pods=kube('get','pods','-n','kube-system','-l','app.kubernetes.io/name=juicefs-csi-driver')['items']
result['csi_containers']=[{'pod':x['metadata']['name'],'containers':[{'name':c['name'],'ready':c['ready'],'image':c['image'],'image_id':c['imageID']} for c in x['status']['containerStatuses']]} for x in pods]
mount=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-juicefs/.config').read_text())
result['mount']={'storage':mount['Format']['Storage'],'filesystem_uuid':mount['Format']['UUID'],'subdir':mount.get('Subdir',''),'writeback':mount.get('Chunk',{}).get('Writeback'),'fuse_writeback':mount.get('FuseOpts',{}).get('EnableWriteback'),'read_only':mount.get('Meta',{}).get('ReadOnly')}
result['environment']={'kernel':run(['uname','-r']),'os':run(['lsb_release','-ds']),'juicefs':run(['/usr/local/bin/juicefs','version']),'postgresql':run(['/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/postgres','--version']),'seaweedfs':run(['/usr/local/bin/weed','version']),'k3s':run(['/usr/local/bin/k3s','--version']),'runsc':run(['/usr/local/bin/runsc','--version'])}
result['binaries']={name:digest(path) for name,path in {'candidate_worker_live_test':'/home/ac-test/candidate_worker_live_test','server':'/home/ac-test/agent-computer-server','juicefs':'/usr/local/bin/juicefs'}.items()}
result['operator_candidate_configuration']=json.loads((p/'candidate-command.json').read_text())
result['kubernetes_configuration']={k:v for k,v in config['kubernetes'].items() if k not in ('token_file','ca_file')}
# A new read-only client has no local disk cache. Check the file written and
# synchronized before the deliberately lost database acknowledgement.
cold=pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-worker-cold');cold.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['META_PASSWORD_FILE']=str(p/'metadata-password')
args=['/usr/local/bin/juicefs','mount','-d','--read-only','--no-usage-report','--cache-dir','memory','--cache-size','0','--buffer-size','64','postgres://jfsmeta@10.0.2.15:5432/jfsmeta?sslmode=disable',str(cold)]
mounted=subprocess.run(args,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
(p/'worker-cold-mount.log').write_text(mounted.stdout);(p/'worker-cold-mount.log').chmod(0o600)
assert mounted.returncode==0,'cold mount failed; private log retained'
try:
    receipt=result['observations'][1]['receipt']
    file=cold/result['volume_path']/receipt['path_ref']/'preserved.txt'
    data=file.read_bytes();assert data==b'preserve-before-observation'
    stats=(cold/'.stats').read_text()
    result['fresh_client_read']={'bytes':len(data),'sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'cache':'new read-only client; cache-dir memory; cache-size 0','object_get_metrics':[s for s in stats.splitlines() if not s.startswith('#') and 'object' in s and 'get' in s.lower()]}
finally:
    subprocess.run(['umount',str(cold)],check=True)
(p/'candidate-worker-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');(p/'candidate-worker-result.json').chmod(0o600)
print('Candidate worker evidence and fresh-client read collected.')

spec:

    matchLabels:

  serviceName: juicefs-csi-controller

    metadata:

        app.kubernetes.io/name: juicefs-csi-driver
        app.kubernetes.io/version: master
    spec:
      containers:
      - args:
        - --endpoint=$(CSI_ENDPOINT)
        - --logtostderr
        - --nodeid=$(NODE_NAME)
        - --leader-election
        - --config=/etc/config/config.yaml
        env:
        - name: CSI_ENDPOINT
          value: unix:///var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/csi.sock
        - name: NODE_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: spec.nodeName
        - name: JUICEFS_MOUNT_NAMESPACE
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.namespace
        - name: POD_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.name
        - name: JUICEFS_MOUNT_PATH
          value: /var/lib/juicefs/volume

          value: /var/lib/juicefs/config

          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3

        ports:
        - containerPort: 9909
          name: healthz
          protocol: TCP
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 1000m
            memory: 1Gi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 512Mi
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            add:
            - SYS_ADMIN
          privileged: true
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/
          name: socket-dir
        - mountPath: /jfs
          mountPropagation: Bidirectional
          name: jfs-dir
        - mountPath: /root/.juicefs
          mountPropagation: Bidirectional
          name: jfs-root-dir
        - mountPath: /etc/config
          name: juicefs-config
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      - args:
        - --csi-address=$(ADDRESS)
        - --timeout=60s
        - --leader-election
        - --v=5
        env:
        - name: ADDRESS
          value: /var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/csi.sock
        image: mirror.gcr.io/rancher/mirrored-sig-storage-csi-provisioner@sha256:608640c92ee853e657ce663bc955f866910858d0f5c746da088ffb497d44a453

      - args:
        - --csi-address=$(ADDRESS)
        - --timeout=20s
        - --leader-election
        - --v=2
        env:
        - name: ADDRESS
          value: /var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/csi.sock
        image: mirror.gcr.io/rancher/mirrored-sig-storage-csi-resizer@sha256:fc764369dcb1dd3a031b6a842e265b7a19766e6817acd1b7bcdd5c413275638b

        - name: ADDRESS

        image: mirror.gcr.io/rancher/mirrored-sig-storage-livenessprobe@sha256:4a1e22167d03746e6748cdc41b6374262c666bc85999e90112edc236dfb2c95a

        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /csi
          name: socket-dir
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

      serviceAccount: juicefs-csi-controller-sa

      - key: CriticalAddonsOnly

        name: socket-dir

        name: jfs-dir
      - hostPath:
          path: /var/lib/juicefs/config
          type: DirectoryOrCreate
        name: jfs-root-dir
      - configMap:
          defaultMode: 420
          name: juicefs-csi-driver-config
        name: juicefs-config
  volumeClaimTemplates: []
